_comment: Batch A staging fragment. Sourced 2026-06-07. Do NOT edit seed.json — integration pass folds this in.
name: Cybex Aton G Swivel

verifiedAttributes._comment: carrierLb / fitsWayfinder / fitsAlterrain / safety map into seed.json; rest is audit trail.
verifiedAttributes.safety: 180° swivel anti-rebound base with load leg (cuts crash forces ~30%) + Linear Side-Impact Protection (L.S.P.) + SafeLock belt tensioner + 11-position no-rethread headrest/harness; GREENGUARD Gold, FMVSS213-compliant, FAA-approved (SensorSafe on some trims)
verifiedAttributes.bobWayfinderAdapter: BOB Wayfinder Infant Car Seat Adapter for Nuna/Cybex/Maxi-Cosi/Britax — ~$59.99 (Strolleria). Universal Wayfinder adapter covers the Cybex Aton family.
verifiedAttributes.bobAlterrainAdapter: BOB Infant Car Seat Adapter for single/jogging strollers (Cybex/Maxi-Cosi/Nuna, 2016+) — $99.99; mounts fit Alterrain & Alterrain PRO.
verifiedAttributes.tacomaFitNotes: No direct Toyota Tacoma data found. Carrier is 17.5" wide — CPST review (Safe in the Seat) says it is 'narrow enough to fit in many 3-across configurations,' but warns the swivel function can't be used when another seat sits directly beside it. No truck-specific seat-to-seat depth or recline-footprint data located.

notes: carrierLb corrected to 9 lb (carrier only — Cybex's lightest; seed stub had 12 w/ carrierLbVerify). The original Aton G Swivel is being phased out and replaced by the Cybex Aton G2 Swivel (~$549.95, in stock); remaining Aton G Swivel stock is thin — ANB ($399.95 non-SensorSafe) and Kidsland ($299.97 clearance, was $499.95) both sold out; Cybex DTC marks it 'no longer available.' Babesta still ships the SensorSafe+base trim at $499.95 (1-2 wk lead) = lowest confirmed in-stock. Both BOB lists (Wayfinder + Alterrain) confirmed.
